question: Should Twitch release artifacts stop bundling their declared runtime dependencies because the managed installation contract supplies them for both fresh installs and upgrades?
rationale: The changed flag modifies package contents and runtime dependency resolution at release time, which cannot be safely inferred from manifest metadata alone.

options.title: Confirm the managed dependency contract
options.body: Verify fresh-install and upgrade artifacts resolve Twurple from the managed runtime, then merge this focused metadata correction.

options.title: Retain dependency bundling
options.body: Keep the current artifact behavior until managed dependency ownership is documented and demonstrated for Twitch releases.

recommendation.title: Confirm the managed dependency contract
recommendation.body: Verify fresh-install and upgrade artifacts resolve Twurple from the managed runtime, then merge this focused metadata correction.
